verdict.rationale: Gmail exposes a well-documented, official public REST API (Gmail API) with endpoints for sending, reading, filtering, watching mailbox changes via push notifications, and scoped OAuth access, all clearly aimed at programmatic/automated use — a strong fit for AI-native agentic access. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt machine-readable spec (probes 404) and community notes point to real limitations in the IMAP fallback path, though the primary REST API itself is unaffected.
